_comment: Edit these numbers to change how findings are ranked. Nothing else needs to change. Risk = SeverityWeight x AreaMultiplier. Effort = Cost + UserImpact. Priority = Risk / Effort.

Roadmap._comment: Now = quick wins. Next = failed, risk at least NextMinRisk and effort at most NextMaxEffort. Later = every other failed check.

AttackPaths.name: Account takeover
AttackPaths.summary: An attacker signs in as a real user with a stolen, guessed or phished password.

AttackPaths.name: Privilege escalation and persistence
AttackPaths.summary: An attacker gains administrative power or plants a way back in.

AttackPaths.name: Mail compromise and phishing
AttackPaths.summary: An attacker reads, forwards or hides mail, or lands phishing in inboxes.

AttackPaths.name: Malware, ransomware and device compromise
AttackPaths.summary: Malicious code runs on a device, or a lost or unmanaged device exposes data.

AttackPaths.name: Data exposure and external access
AttackPaths.summary: Data leaves through sharing, guests or connected apps.

AttackPaths.name: Blind spots: logging and detection gaps
AttackPaths.summary: An attack would go unseen, or the evidence would not exist afterwards.

AttackPaths.name: Platform hygiene and configuration drift
AttackPaths.summary: General settings that weaken the platform and make the other paths easier.
